analysis: The PR changes only docs/reference/configuration.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds one table row at about head line 313 for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL. The row documents an exact-'0' kill switch, default on, read once per process, not forwarded to LaunchAgents. It governs the fused causal SDPA path in CBv2 AttentionV1.swift for full-attention prompt chunks, excluding live packed paged KV. This is documentation only, with no code, auth, key, attestation, protocol, or storage changes, so no threat-model assets (A-001..A-017) or boundaries (TB-002/003/007/009/010/011) are directly altered. Residual question for integration: the row describes a separate source change to the inference kernel path (libs/mlx-swift-lm AttentionV1.swift), and that source was not supplied, so I cannot confirm that the documented behavior matches it. Any such kernel change is a numerical and performance change in TB-007 and does not itself touch the prefix-cache surface in T-041, though it could affect cache-hit and miss timing (the SEC-035 oracle) only in the accepted-risk sense. Because the env var is not forwarded to LaunchAgents, no new operator-controlled launchd attack surface is introduced. The patch excerpt is truncated but the range map is complete, and the only changed head lines are 3 and 313. No findings.
